insight: Founder Avi Schiffmann paid $1.8M for the friend.com domain and over $1M on a NYC subway ad blitz that became a graffiti magnet.
name: Friend
tagline: Always-listening AI companion pendant that texts you about your day.
description: Friend is a wearable AI companion: a microphone pendant that listens to your day over Bluetooth and sends proactive, personality-driven comments and conversation through its iOS app. The $129 device is a one-time purchase with no subscription, and a free web chatbot lives at friend.com. It does not speak aloud — replies arrive as text messages.

modelSupport.notes: Vendor-chosen cloud LLM; no user model choice.

edge: Unlike chat-app companions, it lives in always-on pendant hardware and initiates comments about your real day — one-time $129, no subscription.

references.title: I tried the viral AI 'Friend' necklace everyone's talking about
How this tiny device became a symbol for the backlash against AI
